test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I kicked the ball.

options.text: The ball is kicked by me.
The ball was kicked by you.
The ball had been kicked by me.
The ball was kicked by me.

solution:
The correct answer is '**The ball had been kicked by me.**'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To convert a sentence from active to passive voice, we need to rearrange the sentence so that the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The original sentence "**I kicked the ball.**" is in the simple past tense.
 
• The correct passive structure for a sentence in the simple past tense is "**was/were + past participle of the main verb.**"
 
• The past participle of "**kick**" is "**kicked**," and since "**the ball**" is singular, we use "**was**."
 
• The sentence correctly transformed into passive voice that retains the original verb tense and meaning is "**The ball was kicked by me.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4**’.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 ("**The ball is kicked by me.**") incorrectly uses the simple present tense "is kicked" instead of the simple past tense.
 
• Option 2 ("**The ball was kicked by you.**") changes the doer of the action from "me" to "you," altering the original sentence's meaning.
 
• Option 3 ("**The ball had been kicked by me.**") uses the past perfect tense, which is not the same as the original simple past tense of the sentence.
